Method of Attack: Delivery via Microsoft Word documents containing malicious VBA macros that execute PowerShell commands
Use of base64 encoded PowerShell commands to download and launch the Trojan
Fileless persistence via Asynchronous Procedure Call (APC) Injection using Windows APIs (VirtualAllocEx, Copy, QueueUserAPC, SleepEx)
Registry modification to store commands for further execution
Command-and-control communication over HTTPS to exfiltrate data archived as CAB files
Attack Vector: Malicious Microsoft Word document with VBA macro
Fileless memory injection via APC Injection
Indicators of Compromise: Hashes of malicious documents distributed by the Ursnif campaign
Payload file names dropped on compromised machines
